# Phase

Phase lets anyone issue their own sovereign coin from inside their AI agent: mint a coin, sign the issuer agreement, and manage a dashboard, marketplace watchlist, and swap offers.

- Test mode only. No real money moves through Phase rails. Balances, prices, and market caps are test-mode figures, not real-money value.
- Trading is manual: trading is placed by the user in the Phase web app, under their own login. An AI agent never buys, sells, or swaps on a user's behalf.

## Agent hook (easiest path)

Paste this to your AI agent:

```
mint my coin -->>is.gd/mintmycoin
```

That link is the Phase agent guide (AGENT.md). It scripts the whole flow: one simple intake form (coin name, ticker, one-line what-is-it, email, legal name), the full Minting Agreement shown before signing, a typed legal-name signature, and standard defaults ($0.50 price, $100K market cap, issuer retains 95% / 200,000 shares). The agent holds the user's Phase access token after signup.

## MCP server (custom connectors)

- Endpoint: https://phase-backend.onrender.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, official MCP SDK)
- Tools (7, all confirm-first): show_coin_setup, show_agreement, sign_agreement, mint_coin, show_dashboard, show_marketplace, set_watchlist
- Auth: tools that need an account take the user's Phase access token as the `accessToken` argument (issued at signup/login). Widgets use short-lived scoped widget tokens and never see the Bearer token.
- OAuth 2.0 (authorization code + PKCE) is live on the same backend for directory connectors: https://phase-backend.onrender.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server

## Phase Cred

Phase Cred is a 0-100 server-computed rating per coin from real records only (agreement, documents, identity, links, funding, profile). It is informational, never a valuation or promise of value. Any red flag (no agreement, gibberish signer, dead link, no/gibberish thesis, bad email domain) caps a coin at Meme.
